definitions.full: H1082. balag [ בָּלַג ] verb gleam, smile (Arabic ) — only Hiph`il Imperfect 1singular with וְ subordinate וְאַבְ֫לִיגָה Job 9:27 2 t.; Participle מַבְלִיג Amos 5:9 ; — 1 shew a smile, look cheerful Psalm 39:14; Job 9:27 ; 10:20 . 2 cause to burst or flash ׳המב עלעָֿ֑ז שֹׁד Amos 5:9 (compare Ew St).
